Prepares or directs the structural design reports, specifications, and plans. Review and approves project submittals, RFIs and supports field activities during construction. Provide professional and technical support to multiple [Company name masked] projects. Day-to-day support and input to internal and external Project Managers.
cond_0084.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in civil/structural engineering from an ABET accredited college, or equivalent practical experience.
EIT/FE or PE required; S.E. Registration a plus.
Around 2 years of structural engineering work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training.
Some familiarity with applicable codes and standards (IBC, ASCE 7, AISC 360, ACI 318).
Background in shallow and deep foundations, including spread footings, slab-on-grade, piles and concrete caissons.
Background in connection and anchorage design such as cast-in-place, post installed, welds and high-strength bolts.
Some familiarity with steel member design, including wide flange, channel, pipe, plate, and angle sections.
Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.) a must.
Experience with structural engineering software such as Mathcad, STAAD, RISA, Enercalc, and LPile a plus.
Exposure to bridge design and evaluation is a plus.
Background in geotechnical engineering, solar and wind energy, transmission and distribution, and substations a plus.
AutoCAD drafting experience is a plus.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in technical writing.
Willingness to pay close attention to detail and check the quality of own and others' work.
Ability to apply sound engineering judgment.
Ability to manage time and workload effectively, including planning, organizing and prioritizing with attention to details.
Minimal travel possible.
cond_0084.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Prepare or direct structural design reports, specifications, and plans. Review and approve project submittals and RFIs, and lead field support activities during construction. Deliver professional and technical contributions across multiple projects. Take direct ownership of day-to-day input to internal and external Project Managers.
cond_0098.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in civil/structural engineering from an ABET accredited college
EIT/FE or PE registration
Minimum 2 years of structural engineering work experience
Familiarity with applicable codes and standards (IBC, ASCE 7, AISC 360, ACI 318)
Knowledge of shallow and deep foundations, including spread footings, slab-on-grade, piles, and concrete caissons
Knowledge of connection and anchorage design such as cast-in-place, post installed, welds, and high-strength bolts
Familiarity with steel member design, including wide flange, channel, pipe, plate, and angle sections
Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.)
Effective verbal communication and technical writing skills
Ability to pay close attention to detail and check the quality of own and others' work
Ability to use sound engineering judgment
Ability to manage time and workload effectively, including planning, organizing, and prioritizing with attention to detail
Preferred Requirements
S.E. Registration
Proficiency with structural engineering software such as Mathcad, STAAD, RISA, Enercalc, and LPile
Knowledge of bridge design and evaluation
Background in geotechnical engineering, solar and wind energy, transmission and distribution, and substations
AutoCAD drafting experience

Responsible for structural design of foundations and ancillary structures for utility scale wind, solar, transmission line, and substation projects.
Prepares or directs the structural design reports, specifications, and plans.
Reviews and approves project submittals and RFIs, and supports field activities during construction.
Provides professional and technical support to multiple [Company name masked] projects.
Provides input to internal and external Project Managers as required by project needs.
cond_0124.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in civil/structural engineering from an ABET accredited college.
EIT/FE or PE required, S.E. Registration a plus.
Minimum 2 years of structural engineering work experience required.
Familiar with applicable codes and standards (IBC, ASCE 7, AISC 360, ACI 318).
Knowledge of shallow and deep foundations, including spread footings, slab-on-grade, piles and concrete caissons.
Knowledge of connection and anchorage design such as cast-in-place, post installed, welds and high-strength bolts.
Familiar with steel member design, including wide flange, channel, pipe, plate, and angle sections.
Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, etc.) a must.
Proficient with structural engineering software, such as Mathcad, STAAD, RISA, Enercalc, and LPile a plus.
Knowledge of bridge design and evaluation is a plus.
Background in geotechnical engineering, solar and wind energy, transmission and distribution, and substations a plus.
AutoCAD drafting experience is a plus.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting skills.
Ability to pay close attention to detail and check the quality of own and others' work.
Ability to use sound engineering judgment.
Ability to manage time and workload effectively, which includes planning, organizing and prioritizing with attention to details.
Minimal travel possible.
